post.originalText:
Inspired by @karpathy's test last month, I decided to see how good Opus 5.5 was at rendering 3D graphics.

I'm taken aback by how good the sound design is more than the graphics themselves.

I gave it the first few paragraphs of Dracula, and asked it to recreate the entire thing using @threejs

After 6 hours of working it came back with this. Compared to @karpathy's test with Opus 5, where he asked it to recreate the first paragraph of Lord of the Rings, the results show a stark spike in capability.

Not only is the scenery significantly improved, it also did an amazing job with the lighting and effects.

I'm particularly in love with the wolf echo it made for the introduction of Dracula.

While the human models can be improved significantly, compared to the rendition of LOR last month, this feels like a 10x or even 20x improvement in skill. 

I'm scared to think what a full blown Mythos-2 would look like creating a movie. 

This is just a first pass. I might spend some more time improving this over the course of the next few weeks.
